title: Load transient: 1mA <-> 50mA step response
claim: Substantiates spec/target-spec.md's DRAFT "Load transient" row (1<->50 mA step, ~1us edges: peak excursion <=150mV, recover to +-1% in <=20us, over the ratified C_out/ESR window) against the LDO core-regulation-loop schematic landed by #14 (design/ldo_3v3in_1v8out.sch). Both the spec row and the C_out/ESR window (spec/decision-records/DR-002, status: proposed) are DRAFT/unratified pending issue #1 -- the bounds below cite those DRAFT numbers directly, not an invented final limit, and need re-verification once #1 and DR-002 rule. This testbench's undershoot/overshoot measurements are computed as the deviation from the pre-step (light-load) steady-state value, not an absolute vout bound. Known-immature-design caveat (design/README.md "Known gaps"): C_COMP/C_CL remain unsized placeholders and the error amplifier still has a light-load/high-VIN output-swing ceiling (design/README.md's "Known open item") even though issue #22 already added the current-limit and soft-start protection circuitry, so a FAIL here -- especially at the high-VIN corner -- is an honest, expected finding at this design stage (per CLAUDE.md's "Verification is the product"), not a harness defect.
statistical_convention: N/A (corner-matrix check, not a distribution claim)

measurements.name: undershoot_v
measurements.note: Worst-case dip below the pre-step (light-load, ~1mA) steady-state value, across the whole transient. DRAFT bound: spec/target-spec.md "Load transient" row, peak excursion <=150mV (DRAFT, unratified).

measurements.name: overshoot_v
measurements.note: Worst-case rise above the pre-step steady-state value (captures ringing on the 50mA->1mA recovery edge). Same DRAFT 150mV bound as undershoot_v.
